_doc: 三源交叉驗證時發現的待後續確認問題。Key = function address, value = {name, issues: [...]}。所有 emit phase 完成後統一解決。

issues.desc: Ghidra decompiled this as __cdecl void with bare 'return;' everywhere, dropping the EAX return values (systematic EAX-tracking bug). The disassembly shows real int returns: most paths XOR EAX,EAX;RET (return 0), but the field-command path @0x118C1-0x118D9 does 'do{r=fd2_field_command_menu_loop();}while(r==0); if(r==1) r^=1; return r;' (MOV EAX,EBX;RET). The single caller fd2_main @0x25DCE consumes EAX (MOV ESI,EAX then TEST ESI;JZ re-invoke), so the return value is load-bearing: a 0 return makes fd2_main loop back into fd2_game_main_loop, non-zero exits. Emitted as int accordingly. Also: the two dispatch-table calls (per_chapter_post_action_handler @0x51B19 and ai_post_action_consequence @0x51B91) push ESI (=selected char idx uVar2) before CALL (PUSH ESI;CALL;ADD ESP,4), so they are invoked with (uVar2); Ghidra rendered them as '()' with no arg — emitted with (sel) per disasm + the (uint32) table prototype in globals.h. Recommend post-build -d disasm to confirm byte-identical return-value computation and the table-call argument.

AP/DP x1.15 buff. Assembly @0x1B7EF-0x1B819 = FILD/FMUL m64[0x5018D]/CALL __CHP/FISTP. __CHP (0x377A4) sets FPU RC=11 (round-toward-zero) then FRNDINT, so the value is TRUNCATED before FISTP stores it — i.e. assembly truncates, it does NOT round-to-nearest. The emitted C (int)((double)x * 1.15) ALSO truncates toward zero, so the rounding DIRECTION matches. Residual concern is only Watcom 9.5a codegen precision (x87 80-bit FMUL vs C 64-bit double intermediate); for unit-test ground-truth this is bypassed by choosing bases where 80-bit and 64-bit truncation agree (100->114, 200->229, tested in testbtl.c). Still recommend a post-build -d disasm to confirm byte-identical FILD/FMUL/__CHP/FISTP emission. [reviewer KEEP-confirmed valid] Precision-ordering refinement: the FMUL at 0x1B7F3 runs BEFORE __CHP sets PC=64-bit, so it uses the entry control-word precision. Cross-check: bases 100->114 and 200->229 agree at 64-bit and exact-80-bit truncation; base 40 would give 46 at 64-bit but 45 at exact-80-bit and was correctly AVOIDED in the tests. Unit tests pass under real Watcom, empirically confirming truncation; a post-build -d disasm to confirm byte-identical FILD/FMUL/__CHP/FISTP emission remains the recommended final check. No code change needed.
issues.reviewer_verdict: KEEP (confirmed valid, no code change needed)

issues.desc: Assembly uses FILD+FMUL+__CHP+FISTP (round-to-nearest by default FPU mode); emitted C uses (int)((double)per_score * multiplier_1_5). For actual values 8*1.5=12 and 24*1.5=36 the result is exact integer so truncation vs rounding doesn't matter, but Watcom codegen may differ.
Assembly 先 REP MOVSD 複製 28-dword resist table 到 stack 再索引；emitted C 直接讀 global。行為等價 (table 不在執行中被修改)，但 machine code 顯著不同。

0x10b43 fd2_noop_stub_b43 屬 SHARED EPILOGUE fragment，正確 skip 不獨立 emit。等價性疑慮：此 fragment 的等價靠『各 parent 的 return; 由 Watcom 9.5a 重新生成 ADD ESP/POP regs/RET』達成，而非 byte-identical。因此 Layer 2 等價驗證的責任轉移到 3 個 +0x00 parent (fd2_load_chapter_battle_data / fd2_play_rising_pre_cast_effect / fd2_play_variant_b_slide_pre_effect) 與 26 個 +0x03 parent 的 epilogue 各自 emit 時 — 屆時須確認每個 parent emit 出的 epilogue stack-cleanup 量(ADD ESP 對應其 locals + saved regs)與原 binary 等價。此非本 fragment 自身可驗，屬下游 parent emit 時的覆蓋點，建議記錄以免遺漏。

原列的 6 個 noop stub 中，c49/1011/1452/13994/15983 經各自 review 後皆確認為 DECOMPILER FRAGMENT（c49/1011/1452/13994 = shared epilogue；15983 = shared return-tail，帶回傳值 MOV EAX,EDI），已改 <fragment:inline-epilogue> skip + plate marker，不再 route 到 util/noop.c。僅剩 fd2_noop_stub_4e915 仍 route 到 util/noop.c（done:true / reviewed:false），待其被 review 時逐一確認；應套用同一 fragment 政策(plate marker + routing skip)、不可預先批次處理。

0x10c49 fd2_noop_stub_c49 屬 SHARED EPILOGUE fragment (calling_convention.md epilogue cluster 0x10c49 = ADD ESP 0x4 + POP EDI/ESI/EBX + RET, locals=0x4 + 3 saved regs; pipeline_spec.md 模式A rule A-1)，正確 skip 不獨立 emit 到 util/noop.c。等價性靠『各 parent 的 return; 由 Watcom 9.5a 重新生成 epilogue』達成，而非 byte-identical。Layer 2 等價驗證責任轉移到 3 個 tail-JMP parent — fd2_convert_battle_tiles_to_24px (JMP @0x13a3f) / fd2_equip_unequip_inventory_menu (JMP @0x1c13d) / fd2_open_party_status_overview_screen (JMP @0x1b418) — 各自 emit 時須確認其 epilogue stack-cleanup 量 (ADD ESP 對應 locals=0x4 + POP EDI/ESI/EBX) 與原 binary 等價。此非本 fragment 自身可驗，屬下游 parent emit 時的覆蓋點。

0x11452 fd2_noop_stub_1452 屬 SHARED EPILOGUE fragment (calling_convention.md epilogue cluster 0x11452 = ADD ESP 0x20 + POP EBP/EDI/ESI/EBX + RET, locals=0x20 + 4 saved regs; pipeline_spec.md rule A-1)，正確 skip 不獨立 emit 到 util/noop.c。等價性靠『各 parent 的 return; 由 Watcom 9.5a 重新生成 epilogue』達成，而非 byte-identical。Layer 2 等價驗證責任轉移到 3 個 +0x00 全 epilogue parent — fd2_animate_spell_projectile_paths (JZ @0x1df7f + JMP @0x1e0d6) / fd2_assemble_dialog_frame_layered (JGE @0x16b39) / fd2_render_inventory_item_grid (JGE @0x186e4)，各有 PUSH EBX/ESI/EDI/EBP + SUB ESP,0x20 prologue — 以及 1 個 +0x03 alt-entry parent fd2_save_runtime_char_to_template (JGE @0x1151f，無 SUB ESP、僅 POP 4 regs)。各自 emit 時須確認其 epilogue stack-cleanup 量 (ADD ESP 對應 locals + POP regs) 與原 binary 等價。此非本 fragment 自身可驗，屬下游 parent emit 時的覆蓋點。

0x13994 fd2_noop_stub_13994 是 SHARED EPILOGUE fragment (calling_convention.md epilogue cluster 0x13994 = ADD ESP 0x5C + POP EBP/EDI/ESI/EBX + RET, locals=0x5C + 4 saved regs; pipeline_spec.md 模式A rule A-1)，已正確 skip、不再 emit 到 util/noop.c。等價性疑慮：此 fragment 的行為（caller-frame unwind + 把 EBP 載入 EAX 當回傳值）需靠唯一 parent fd2_play_ending_and_record_clear 的 return ebp_value; 由 Watcom 9.5a 重新生成 epilogue「等價」，而非 byte-identical。Layer 2 跨檔語意驗證責任轉移到 parent emit 時確認：parent 的 PUSH EBX/ESI/EDI/EBP + SUB ESP,0x5c (@0x1f89e) prologue 對應的 stack-cleanup 段 (ADD ESP 還原 locals=0x5C + POP EBP/EDI/ESI/EBX) 與原 binary 相同，且 MOV EAX,EBP (@0x1ff72) 的回傳值語意被 return 述句保留。非由 fragment 自身可驗，待下游 parent emit 時的覆蓋點。

0x15983 屬 SHARED RETURN/EPILOGUE fragment（calling_convention.md epilogue cluster 0x15983；非 no-op，帶回傳值）。Disasm = MOV EAX,EDI; JMP 0x22bbe；0x22bbe = ADD ESP,4 + POP EBP/EDI/ESI/EBX + RET（與 fd2_composite_battle_frame_zero @0x22bb7 共用 epilogue）。已正確 skip、不獨立 emit 到 util/noop.c。等價性靠『各 parent 的 return 由 Watcom 9.5a 重新生成 MOV EAX,<retval> + 對應 stack-cleanup epilogue』達成，而非 byte-identical。Layer 2 等價驗證責任轉移到兩個 parent 各自 emit 時：(1) fd2_score_item_candidate @0x15880（target battle/btl_ai.c，已 reviewed）— 3 條 early-exit conditional jump，EDI=total_score，須確認 emit 出的 `return total_score;` 在 -d 反組譯後等於 MOV EAX,EDI + (ADD ESP,0x4 還原 locals=0x4 + POP EBX/ESI/EDI/EBP + RET)；(2) fd2_alloc_and_blit_indexed_sprite_chunk @0x15f0e（target gfx/blit.c，phase 5 未 emit）— tail-JMP @0x15f7f，EDI=malloc buffer pointer，須確認其回傳值語意（目前 Ghidra 簽名標 void，emit 時應依 MOV EAX,EDI 將其視為回傳 buffer pointer 並保留），且 prologue PUSH EBX/ESI/EDI/EBP + SUB ESP,0x4 對應的 cleanup 與原 binary 等價。此非本 fragment 自身可驗，屬下游 parent emit 時的覆蓋點。

00015983 fragment_equivalence_handoff is correctly logged and accurate. Reiterate for downstream: parent2 fd2_alloc_and_blit_indexed_sprite_chunk @0x15f0e (gfx/blit.c, currently done:false / not emitted) returns the malloc'd buffer pointer via this fragment's MOV EAX,EDI even though its Ghidra signature is 'void'. When that parent is emitted, its return type MUST be a pointer (it returns the buffer allocated at CALL 0x36d16 / MOV EDI,EAX @0x15f51), and the SUB ESP,0x4 + PUSH EBX/ESI/EDI/EBP cleanup must regenerate equivalently. parent1 fd2_score_item_candidate @0x15880 (battle/btl_ai.c, already reviewed:true) returns int total_score; verify its emitted `return total_score;` disassembles to MOV EAX,EDI + the 0x18 cleanup.

Single-read-reuse vs double-volatile-read on BIOS_TICK_WORD at 0x46C (store-to-0x539F0 + comparison): the original reuses one read; emitted C reads twice. Documented as unobservable because 0x539F0 has 0 readers binary-wide. If a wlink ORDER/byte-layout audit later cares about the exact bytes written to 0x539F0, note this write can lag the comparison value by one tick relative to the original. Recommend an inline comment in input.c near line 474 stating 0x539F0 is a dead/write-only latch (0 readers) so the double-read is intentional-equivalent.

Equivalence note for the emitter to record: data_fd2_ui_menu_cursor_idx assignment. Asm stores full 32-bit EAX (MOV [0x53c57],EAX at 0x1508b) and then PUSHes that same EAX to fd2_get_item_effect_entry. C truncates to uint8 item_id then zero-extends (uint32)item_id. This is EXACT because the source fd2_get_inventory_slot_item_id (0x1b722) ends in MOVZX EAX,byte ptr [EAX]; RET so EAX upper 24 bits are guaranteed 0. The Ghidra decompile CONCAT31(extraout_var,item_id) is conservative-only; the C is correct. Worth a one-line comment in the source so a future reviewer does not re-flag the CONCAT31.

Test-deferral note (mandatory per risk-based policy): emitter should record in the emit output that test coverage for fd2_execute_ai_item_use is deferred to Phase 9 integration, with the reason that the function is display/animation orchestration and its only arithmetic block (interp+clamp) is display-bound (drives cursor pan only, not effect dispatch). This explicit deferral note is currently MISSING.

FAITHFUL EQUIVALENCE (not a defect): local 'last_tick' (asm reg ESI) is read-before-write on the first loop iteration -- ESI is never initialized before CMP ESI,EAX at 0x18bc1, and the emitted C 'int last_tick;' is likewise uninitialized, read at input.c:241 before its first assignment at input.c:261. On iteration 1 the status-panel repaint MAY be skipped depending on the garbage value vs the current tick. The emitted C correctly PRESERVES this original (technically-UB) behavior; Watcom 9.5a register-allocates last_tick with no implicit init, matching the original binary. Logged so the intentional non-initialization is documented -- a future tool/reviewer must NOT 'fix' it by zero-initializing last_tick (that would diverge from the binary).

Test deferral for this display-only function is not recorded anywhere (no note in input.c, routing.json, or a tests file). Risk-based policy requires display deferrals be noted with reason. Suggest adding a brief 'Phase 9 integration: display-only, no assertable non-display effect' deferral marker near the function in src/input/input.c or in the tests file.

SAME bug just fixed in sibling fd2_execute_attack_damage_calculation @0x1ECC7 (battle.c). The terrain AP/DP block here (battle.c:268-269, 302-316) declares 'uint32 tile_attr_buf;' (4 bytes) + a SEPARATE 'uint8 tile_id;' that is NEVER assigned from the buffer, then indexes data_fd2_battle_tile_attr_mv_modifier_table[tile_id] / _def_modifier_table[tile_id] on the uninitialized tile_id. Ghidra get_function_variables on 0x29F72 confirms tile_attr_word = Stack[-0x4c]:4 and tile_attr_byte = Stack[-0x47]:1, and -0x4c+5 = -0x47, i.e. the real table index is buffer[+5] (= attr_ptr[+1] from the 8-byte writer fd2_read_tile_attribute_at_pos). Two defects: (1) wrong terrain modifier index (reads garbage stack instead of tile_attr_buf[5]); (2) the helper writes out_buf[+0..+7] (8 bytes) into a 4-byte local -> 4-byte stack overflow. Out of scope for the 0x1ECC7 fix round (different function); MUST be fixed when fd2_calculate_combat_hit_outcome is reviewed, using the same pattern as the proven-correct btl_ai.c reference (uint8 tile_attr_buf[8]; pass (uint32)tile_attr_buf; tile_id = tile_attr_buf[5]; before each modifier-table index). Reference fix landed at battle.c fd2_execute_attack_damage_calculation and the passing test test_eatk_terrain_ap_bonus in testbtl.c.

00035c15.name: fd2_set_battle_anim_phase_to_1
issues: 跨函式相依（給 phase 7 emit fd2_chapter_event_handler_52__ch30_major_cinematic@0x35f92 的 emitter）：本函式（Pattern A SHARED EPILOGUE STUB，pipeline_spec.md:526）以 standalone `void(void)` setter 形式 emit。其 Layer-2 等價性「成立的前提」是唯一 main-entry consumer handler_52 必須 emit 為一般 cdecl C（呼叫前一個 3-param cdecl callee 後由 caller 自身清 args，再普通呼叫 fd2_set_battle_anim_phase_to_1()）。handler_52 decomp 已天然呈現此形（两條 path 結尾皆 `...(...); fd2_set_battle_anim_phase_to_1(); return;`），故照常 emit 即可；emitter 不可嘗試複刻原 binary 的 tail-JMP 或省略 caller 端 cdecl arg cleanup，否則會破壞 stack 平衡。

alt-entry（0x35C18 / 0x35C22）由 fd2_chapter_event_handler_17 / _25 透過 JMP 消費，與本 main-entry（0x35C15）為不同位址；那兩個 handler 的 fall-through/tail-share emit 屬其各自回合處理，本函式 standalone setter 不負責 alt-entry 的 stack 語意。

issues.desc: Equivalence note for emitter record: return-value-in-EAX is a direct memory load (MOV EAX,[0x5275c]) with no intervening CALL, so it is NOT subject to the Ghidra EAX-after-CALL tracking bug; decompiler captured it correctly and no assembly override was needed.

cc justification: __cdecl 1-stack-arg derived from disassembly only (param at [ESP+4], bare RET = caller cleanup), because the function has 0 static callers (cannot derive from caller ADD ESP,K). Preserved-as-original; matches identical sibling @ 0x3615e.

Unit test for the high-risk numeric/branch paths of fd2_dpmi_alloc_dos_memory (CF success/failure branch; the three output computations out_segment=eax<<16 / out_linear=(eax&0xFFFF)<<4 / out_selector=edx&0xFFFF; the off-by-one page-lock arithmetic lock(seg>>12, paragraphs*16+(seg>>12)-1)) is DEFERRED to Phase 9 integration. Reason (proven, not convenience): these paths are reachable only via int386(), which has no deterministic unit-test seam in the DOS/4GW harness. (1) A test-local int386 override to inject the DPMI host result was implemented and proven by bisection to deterministically crash/hang the DOS/4GW runtime -- overriding the CRT int386 breaks the extender's protected-mode interrupt reflection that the CRT itself depends on, so the test executable faults before reaching the dpmi suite; with the override disabled the same build completes (369 pass + the 3 dpmi tests fail on real DPMI non-determinism). int386 is also used by src/input/input.c, whose suite depends on the real INT 16h. (2) Letting the real int386 service INT 31h fn 0x100 allocates real, non-deterministic DOS conventional memory and locks real pages with no paired free here -- leak-prone and unassertable on exact values. Deferral is documented in the src/util/dpmi.c file header. Equivalence of the bit-math was verified statically line-by-line against the assembly (0x36206 SHL EAX,0x10; 0x3620f AND/0x36214 SHL; 0x36221 AND; 0x36237 SHR EAX,0xc; 0x3623e SHL EDX,0x4; 0x36241 ADD; 0x36243 DEC).
issues.source_review: fd2_dpmi_alloc_dos_memory @000361cc (emitter fix-round; int386 override proven to crash DOS/4GW)

issues.desc: Class-3 shared-tail equivalence-by-regeneration. fd2_dpmi_unlock_region's INT 31h dispatch tail (asm @0x362a7) is shared via JMP from inside fd2_dpmi_lock_region (@0x36284) and is NOT byte-identical-preserved. The baseline emits both fd2_dpmi_lock_region and fd2_dpmi_unlock_region as independent full functions and relies on Watcom 9.5a regenerating an equivalent int386 dispatch + cflag-return in each. Layer-2 equivalence rests on that regeneration, not on preserving the original JMP-into-sibling tail. Logged per project convention for Class-3 shared-tail / shared-epilogue equivalence-by-regeneration concerns (cf. the 00010b43 and 00015983 fragment_equivalence_handoff entries). verify_method: post-build -d disasm to confirm each function emits a SUB ESP,0x38 frame + correct DWORDREGS packing + int386 + cflag SETZ.

Benign under the well-formed-stream vendor invariant and consistent with sibling row RLE handler @0x36BCE; should be captured as a known Layer-2 equivalence assumption for the decoder family.

issues.desc: emulate_function 對 0x60079 區段的 memory 覆寫無效（回傳恆為 EAX=0x94，與 input memory 內容無關），疑為該 data region 在 program image 未 mapped/initialized，emulator 讀寫 fall-through。故本 function 的期望值 (8) 改以 disasm+decomp 不可分歧邏輯做手算驗證：depth=4, dir bytes[0,0,1,1], prev=0xFF → transitions=2 → 2<<2=8，與 ASSERT_EQ(result,8) 相符。後續若需 emulate 驗 pathfind globals 類 function 需注意此限制。

checksum-mismatch arm 的單元測試延後到 Phase 9 integration。該 arm 在 fd2_save_compute_checksum(pBuf,0x59CB) != *(uint*)(pBuf+0x59C7) 時呼叫 fd2_load_chapter_portrait / fd2_display_dialog_scene / fd2_paint_portrait_to_dialog_area / fd2_wait_for_input_dialog_with_blink / fd2_close_status_screen_with_slide_out。其中 fd2_wait_for_input_dialog_with_blink 是 real linked function（src/input/input.c），內含 while(fd2_check_keyboard_buffer_nonempty()==0){...} busy-wait 等待鍵盤輸入，在 silent 自動化 harness 無輸入時會無限 hang（已用 bisection 證實）。該 arm 只多一個 error dialog（display + blocking input）後 fall-through 回到與 match 路徑相同的 restore，已由 test_load_save_restores_scalar_state / test_load_save_cinematic_loop_counts 涵蓋。

已單元測試（風險導向）：scalar restore（chapter/party/turn/gold/cursor/view-origin/audio flags 全部從 save header tail 還原）、tile-map width/height 與 portrait-cache header（tile_event[1]/[2]）的 derived state、portrait-rebuild loop call count、兩段 cinematic loop 的 frame 計數（含 zoom loop 的 i==5->i=9 skip = 9+4=13 alloc/cleanup）、結尾 anim_phase=1 / current_active_char_idx=0。純 blit/display 副作用（實際像素輸出）依風險導向政策延後 Phase 9。fixture 在 C:\(=src mount) 寫 FD2.SAV/FDICON.B24/FD2.TMP 後 teardown remove，並還原所有被 load 改動的 globals。

此函式正常路徑結尾 CALL fd2_load_chapter_portraits_and_dump_tmp(0) 後 fall-through 進共用 epilogue fragment fd2_noop_stub_b43 @ 0x10b43 (ADD ESP,0xc / POP EBP/EDI/ESI/EBX / RET)。emit 為 plain return；等價靠 Watcom 9.5a 重新生成等量 stack cleanup + saved-reg restore，非 byte-identical。對應 00010b43 handoff 的 +0x00 parent 覆蓋點。verify_method: post-build -d disasm 確認本函式 epilogue 的 ADD ESP 量與 POP 順序對應其 4 個 saved reg (EBX/ESI/EDI/EBP) + locals。

兩條失敗路徑 (malloc fail / fopen fail) 原 binary 為 PUSH <msg>; JMP 0x10056，共用 sibling fd2_load_save_and_init_engine 的 tail：CALL printf; ADD ESP,4; PUSH 1; JMP exit。即實際 exit code 固定為 1。Ghidra decomp 將 PUSH 1 誤渲染為 exit(pRuntime_char_alloc)（fopen 結果變數）——為 decomp artifact。emit 採真實行為 exit(1)，與 sibling main.c 既有慣例一致。OOM 字串用 pooled global data_fd2_string_field_map_oom_msg_chapter_runtime_50064 @0x50064，file-not-found 用 data_fd2_string_field_map_fdicon_not_found_err_50086 @0x50086。

Register-liveness edge (-0x11 ENEMY slot1 with target==0x27): the binary animates at the position held in EDI, which can have been set by a *previous* -0x12/-0x14 op (EDI <- current_speaker @0x1628c / runtime_char @0x1642b). The emitted C var pSpeaker is updated only in the -0x11(!=0x27) and -0x13 branches, NOT in -0x12/-0x14, so after a -0x12-then-(-0x11 with id 0x27) sequence the C would use a stale pSpeaker while the binary uses the -0x12 speaker. This is the documented liveness caveat in the function header. It does not affect compile/exec for the common single-portrait scripts and the first-use/garbage case is equally undefined in both; logged so a future pass can decide whether to mirror EDI exactly across all four portrait branches if such a script sequence is ever observed.
issues.verify_method: static-only; no observed script triggers -0x12-then-(-0x11 id 0x27); revisit if such sequence found

issues.desc: flip!=0 的 cursor-pan + 線性內插 blit 迴圈未做 unit test：它呼叫真 emit 的 fd2_pan_cursor_to_tile_animated (cursor.obj) 與 fd2_blit_indexed_sprite_with_alloc (blitspr.obj)，兩者寫 VRAM 0xA0000 並依賴 cursor 硬體狀態，屬純 display 副作用，依 test 政策延到 Phase 9 integration。已測 flip==0 deterministic 路徑 (default-origin 對映 0x728->2 / 0x9017->0x70 / else 0、5 次 malloc、width=flip*0x140+5、5-stage assemble 常數表 (4,2)(8,3)(0xC,4)(0x10,5)(0x13,5) 與 dst_origin 轉發)。

內插式 interp_y = cursor_y_pixel - ((int)(cursor_y_pixel-flip)*step)/total_steps 與 interp_x = cursor_x_pixel - ((int)(cursor_x_pixel-5)*step)/total_steps 對應 binary 的 IMUL+IDIV (SAR EDX,0x1f 號擴展) 帶號乘除。C 用帶號 int 乘除等價，但 step/total_steps 邊界 (step==total_steps 時商=被除數) 之 round-toward-zero 行為須在實機/emulator 確認與 Watcom 9.5a IDIV codegen 完全一致。inputs(cursor 像素) 需真 pan 才會填，故與上面延後覆蓋點同批驗。

Phase-9 follow-up: add a test for the flip!=0 cursor-pan + interp_x/interp_y interpolation path of fd2_play_dialog_open_animation once a recording-stub or integration harness can capture the blitter's x/y args without colliding with the real linked fd2_blit_indexed_sprite_with_alloc used by gfx/blitspr.c. Expected values per step: interp_x=cursor_x_pixel-((cursor_x_pixel-5)*step)/total_steps, interp_y=cursor_y_pixel-((cursor_y_pixel-flip)*step)/total_steps, cursor_*_pixel=cursor_screen_*×0x18+4, total_steps=sx+sy.

Pure blit/display orchestrator. No isolated unit test: it calls the real-linked fd2_load_dat_resource with the hardcoded in-binary filename pointer 0x51a70 (DATO.DAT string). In the test binary that address does not hold a valid path, and the real loader does exit(1) on fopen failure, aborting the whole test run; fd2_load_dat_resource is already linked real (rsrc.c) so it cannot be stubbed, and DATO.DAT is not in build_test.py staged GAME_FILES. Cannot test without distorting the emit code (replacing 0x51a70 with a string global) which is forbidden. Deterministic behavior to verify at Phase 9 integration: data_fd2_dialog_active_portrait_blit_offset set to 0xC88; portrait_pixels = buf + *buf; three fd2_dialog_sprite_blit_normal dst offsets overlay_buffer+0xC88 / +0x91C / +0x7585; UI sprite sources sheet_ptr + *(int*)(sheet_ptr+0x56) and +0x5A; portrait_id selected as runtime_char[char_idx].portrait_id; trailing fd2_render_full_char_stat_panel(char_idx, overlay_buffer).

c_changed flag was reported false but the diff is a real code emit of fd2_player_action_menu_loop plus 2 new tests and a new global — future rounds should set c_changed=true and list test_cases_added when the function body is emitted, even if a plate fact-correction also happened in the same round.

Wait-loop redraw gate compares the live BIOS tick to last_tick, which the binary NEVER writes: it is the caller leftover EBP at entry (asm 0x1B2FE CMP EAX,EBP; EBP is not set anywhere in this function nor in the single caller fd2_field_menu_status_save_load_quit_dispatch @0x19DF7, which uses ESP-relative framing). Emitted faithfully as int32 last_tick declared-but-never-assigned (Watcom 9.5a default -w1 produces NO warning; build gate 0 warnings). Observable behavior is identical to the binary: the redraw (palette tick + scene recomposite + content re-render + blit to 0xA0504) fires whenever (int16)*0x46C != that fixed indeterminate value, i.e. essentially every iteration, until a key is pressed. The exact garbage value differs between binary (specific call-chain EBP) and rebuild (compiler storage choice), but it is consumed ONLY by this one redraw-gate comparison and gates a pure display side effect, so no downstream logic depends on the specific value -> functionally equivalent. Residual check: post-build -d disasm to confirm Watcom emits the same MOVSX word ptr[0x46C] / CMP-against-indeterminate / conditional-skip shape.

Ghidra EAX-tracking artifact resolved by reading asm. After fread(backbuf,1,0xAD,fp) (CALL 0x37072 -> EAX=bytes read) the asm does MOV AX,word ptr [ESI+0xa5] (0x204ea) overwriting only the low 16 bits of EAX, then MOV [ESP+0x10],EAX (0x204f1). The decomp renders this as frame_count_pack = CONCAT22((short)(uVar3>>0x10), *(undefined2*)(backbuf+0xa5)) and the loop uses (short)frame_count_pack -- i.e. only the low 16 bits, sign-extended. The high 16 bits (the fread return leftover) are dead. Emitted cleanly as int16 frame_count = *(int16*)(backbuf+0xA5); loop `for(i=0;i<(int)frame_count;i++)`. Semantically exact; verified against real ANI.DAT (anim 0 header[0xA5]=96, anim 1=51).

Original tail is JMP 0x19518 (0x205af), the shared __CHK epilogue (ADD ESP / POP regs / RET). Emitted as plain return; equivalence relies on Watcom 9.5a regenerating an equivalent SUB ESP,0x14 + 4-saved-reg (EBX/ESI/EDI/EBP) frame cleanup, not byte-identical (same idiom as the 0x10b43 fragment_equivalence_handoff family). The compiler-inserted __CHK(0x38) stack probe at entry (PUSH 0x38; CALL 0x36cd7) is likewise NOT emitted (regenerated by the compiler), consistent with the rsrc.c emit idiom. verify_method: post-build -d disasm to confirm the frame size + POP order.

Unit test DEFERRED to Phase 9 integration (proven, not convenience). The function is a file-I/O + decode-to-VGA + display orchestrator: every animation in the real ANI.DAT has >=12 frames, so any invocation reaches the REAL fd2_ani_decoder_decode_frame_bytes (anidec.obj is linked) on frame 0, BEFORE the skip-on-key check, with no seam to exit the loop earlier. The real decoder dispatches each chunk byte through the 10-entry data_fd2_animation_ani_decoder_frame_dispatch_table; running it safely over real frame bytes needs the real chunk handlers (a no-op stub that does not advance the cursor turns raw frame bytes into out-of-range table indices >=10 -> OOB call), and installing the full real handler set performs a complete multi-frame decode that writes to 0xA0000 -- an end-to-end decode of the real cinematic, i.e. integration, not a unit test of this orchestrator. The remaining observables are display/timing side effects only (VGA pixels, __delay_thunk_375b2 spy, real BIOS keyboard poll, intro chime via fd2_play_sfx_with_handle spy), which the risk-based test policy defers to Phase 9. The non-display risk (TOC offset anim_idx*4+6, stream-offset seek, header[0xA5] frame-count read) was verified directly against the real ANI.DAT during emit and the emitted C mirrors the disassembly. Deferral is documented in tests/anim/anispell.c header. Phase 9 test: install the real handler table, drive against staged real ANI.DAT, assert the decoder receives exactly header[0xA5] frames with the independent per-frame decoded-size sequence, the intro chime fires once on frame 0 for anim_idx==1 and is stopped+freed on exit, and the skip-on-key path breaks early when the BIOS keyboard buffer is made non-empty.

Unit test deferred to Phase 9 integration (risk-based policy). This is a pure VGA/VRAM cinematic pre-cast slide animation: both loops unconditionally blit each frame to the hardcoded mode-13h framebuffer 0xA0504 via fd2_blit_rectangle, and the only computed state (cursor_screen_x = cursor_x*0x18+0xc / cursor_screen_y = cursor_y*0x18+0x10 tile->pixel transform; the radius accumulator offset0 += step over 9 frames; the slide-up fixed radius offset0-step; the 16 tile-anim sprite-table lookups) is observable only through fd2_render_filled_circle_band_anim, which writes the large game-state buffer and the palette-remap blitter, behind those unconditional blits. There is no RNG / damage / state-transition branch to assert at unit level (unlike the scatter leaf @0x21db2 in the same file). Deferral documented in tests/spell/spellcin.c header (worker #6 of 6). Equivalence verified statically: cdecl 2-arg (offset0, step) confirmed via all 4 caller thunks pushing (1,2)/(2,4)/(8,4)/(6,6) + ADD ESP,0x8; phase-1 loop EBX 9..1 with ESI radius accumulator (ADD ESI,step each frame); phase-2 loop EBX 3..9 with radius held at the SUB ESI,step value (= offset0-step) reused unchanged. The shared-epilogue tail-JMP to fd2_noop_stub_b43 @0x10b43 is emitted as a plain return per the existing 00010b43 fragment_equivalence_handoff (this function is one of its listed +0x00 parents).

AoE scatter X/Y. Assembly @0x21E1A-0x21E38 (X) and 0x21E64-0x21E80 (Y) do FLD cos/sin + FILD radius + FMUL + FILD origin + FADDP (+FADD m64[0x50200] for Y) + CALL __CHP + FISTP. __CHP @0x377A4 sets RC=11 (round-toward-zero) via OR-high-byte-0x1F then FRNDINT, so the value is TRUNCATED toward zero before FISTP. Emitted C uses plain (int)(double) casts which also truncate toward zero, so the rounding DIRECTION matches. Residual concern is only Watcom 9.5a codegen precision: the x87 FMUL/FADD run at the entry control-word precision (80-bit internal) whereas the emitted C uses 64-bit double intermediates, so a result whose true value sits within ~1 ULP of an integer could truncate to a different integer. The two unit tests bypass this by choosing RNG seeds (0x1234 radius1 ang133, 0x5555 radius6 ang293) whose X/Y fractional parts are ~0.32-0.73 of a pixel from any integer boundary, where 64-bit and 80-bit truncation agree; the RNG seed sequence itself was confirmed exact via Ghidra emulate_function on 0x4E893. The deg->rad factor is the binary literal 0.0174532 (af99d76c40df913f @0x501F8), emitted verbatim. Recommend a post-build -d disasm to confirm byte-identical FILD/FMUL/FADDP/__CHP/FISTP emission and the 0.0174532 / -8.0 constant fixups.

The normal path has no explicit RET: the function tail-JMPs (JMP 0x18888 @0x2246b) into the MIDDLE of an adjacent function, fd2_render_decimal_number_to_buffer @0x187d6. 0x18888 is that function's standard Watcom epilogue tail (ADD ESP,0x1C / POP EBP / POP EDI / POP ESI / POP EBX / RET), which is byte-identical to the epilogue this function's own prologue (PUSH EBX/ESI/EDI/EBP + SUB ESP,0x1C) would require, so the Watcom 9.5a compiler shared it (the same 0x18888 tail is also reached from fd2_blit_scaled_tile_map_view @0x1f6a5). Emitted as a plain 'return;'; the compiler regenerates the matching epilogue. This is a binary code-layout detail (Pattern A SHARED EPILOGUE per pipeline_spec.md), Layer-2 equivalent, not byte-identical. Recommend a post-build -d disasm to confirm the regenerated epilogue restores EBX/ESI/EDI/EBP and adjusts ESP identically.

The normal path has no explicit RET: the function tail-JMPs (JMP 0x10B46 @0x2474F) into the shared inline-epilogue fragment fd2_noop_stub_b43 @0x10B43, entering at +0x03. 0x10B46 = ADD ESP,0x8 / POP EBP / POP EDI / POP ESI / POP EBX / RET, which exactly unwinds this function's prologue (PUSH EBX/ESI/EDI/EBP + SUB ESP,0x8). So this is one of the 26 +0x03 parents of the 0x10b43 shared-epilogue fragment (see the 00010b43 fragment_equivalence_handoff). Note: the entry chosen is +0x03 (0x10B46) NOT +0x00 (0x10B43) because the preceding instruction was CALL fd2_load_status_effect_sfx (0-arg, no stack cleanup), so the extra ADD ESP,0x4 at 0x10B43 is skipped; the +0x00 parents (e.g. fd2_load_chapter_battle_data, fd2_play_variant_b_slide_pre_effect) enter at 0x10B43 to also clean a 4-byte pushed arg. Emitted as a plain 'return;'; the compiler regenerates the matching SUB ESP,0x8 + 4-saved-reg (EBX/ESI/EDI/EBP) cleanup. Layer-2 equivalent, not byte-identical. Recommend a post-build -d disasm to confirm the regenerated epilogue restores EBX/ESI/EDI/EBP and adjusts ESP identically.

Unit test DEFERRED to Phase 9 integration (risk-based policy). This is a pure VGA/VRAM cinematic: the 9-frame shockwave loop unconditionally blits each frame to the hardcoded mode-13h framebuffer 0xA0504 via fd2_blit_rectangle, and the trailing palette flash-fade loop writes the VGA DAC hardware ports via fd2_set_vga_palette_range_with_add (its only callee besides __CHK is outp). The only computed state — the epicenter tile->pixel transform (tile*0x18 + 0xC / +0x10), the radius accumulator (radius += radius_increment over 9 frames, the EAX-bug-free [ESP+0x28] 4th-param add @0x246FB), the 9-entry self-relative sprite-table lookup (data_fd2_tile_anim_table_base[6 + frame*4]+base), and the 0x40-step/+2 brightness sweep — is observable only through the real-linked VRAM/DAC-touching callees (fd2_composite_battle_tile_map, fd2_render_filled_circle_band_anim, fd2_blit_rectangle, fd2_set_vga_palette_range_with_add) and the real SFX bank loader (fd2_load_status_effect_sfx fopens FDOTHER.DAT, fd2_play_sfx_with_handle drives AIL), none of which has a stubbable seam. There is no RNG / damage / state-transition branch to assert at unit level (unlike the scatter leaf @0x21db2 in the same file). This matches the deferral of the 9 sibling cinematic workers in this file. Deferral documented in tests/spell/spellcin.c header (worker #10). Equivalence verified statically: cdecl 4-arg (epicenter_tile_x, epicenter_tile_y, radius, radius_increment) confirmed via stack-offset tracking ([ESP+0x1c]=p1, [ESP+0x20]=p2, [ESP+0x24]=p3->ESI radius accumulator, [ESP+0x28]=p4 radius_increment); the 4th Ghidra param name 'epicenter_tile_x' is a duplicate-name artifact and is actually the per-frame radius increment.

The binary indexes the 3-layer BG cache as a uint32[3] at 0x5410B/0F/13 via PUSH dword ptr [EDX*4 + 0x5410B] (EDX = frame%3 in phase 1, (frame+2)%3 in phase 3). globals.h declares the three slots as separate extern uint32 (data_fd2_battle_special_cinematic_bg_layer_0/1/2_buf_ptr), so the emitted C reproduces the array access via 'uint32 *bg_layer = &data_..._layer_0_buf_ptr; bg_layer[idx]'. This is only well-defined if the linker places the three globals contiguously in declaration order (4 bytes apart). They ARE defined consecutively (testglob.c lines 95-97, declaration order layer_0,layer_1,layer_2) and Watcom 9.5a lays file-scope objects in definition order within the data segment, matching the original 0x5410B/0F/13 layout. A redefinition as a real uint32[3] array was rejected to avoid touching the existing scalar references in spell/spellcin.c (which read/write the three names individually). Recommend a post-build -d disasm / map check to confirm &layer_1 == &layer_0+4 and &layer_2 == &layer_0+8 in the linked image.

UNIT-TESTED (risk-based): the only non-display computation -- the 3-layer BG modulo cycling bg_layer[frame%3] (phase 1) / bg_layer[(frame+2)%3] (phase 3), the per-phase blit dst/stride, and the 9..0 loop counts -- is asserted by test_bg_zoom_transition_bg_cycling (tests/anim/anispell.c) driving the REAL function. fd2_rle_blit_sprite is a recording stub (testglob.c) that logs each resolved BG-layer pointer + dst into g_rle_blit_log_*; the three BG-layer globals are set to distinguishable sentinels and the test asserts phase-1 indices [0,2,1,0,2,1,0,2,1,0] (first 10 logged blits, dst=workspace) and phase-3 indices [2,1,0,2,1,0,2,1,0,2] (last 10 logged blits, dst=workspace+0x140), both at stride 0x280. This pins the signed-IDIV-by-3 == C %, the +2 phase-3 rotation, and the loop bounds. The intervening phase-2 fd2_flash_char_hit_sprite is REAL-linked and runs the real fd2_render_mini_char_status_panel + fd2_display_dialog_scene; those are stood up by the shared minipfix.h fixture (the SAME fixture that drives fd2_flash_char_hit_sprite end-to-end in tests/battle/battle2.c -- contrary to an earlier deferral note, the sprite-sheet/all-game-text/dialog seam DOES exist and is reused here). Buffer sizing from disasm: workspace>=0x1F400 (phase-2 memset); clear_buf>=0x19000 because the phase-2 blit_rectangle(workspace,0x280,clear_buf,0x140,0x140,0xC8) reads a contiguous 0xC8*0x140=0x19000 bytes of clear_buf. All callees are void; no EAX return value is consumed, so no EAX-tracking risk. DEFERRED to Phase 9 integration: only the pure VGA pixel output (the actual scrolled bytes written to 0xA0000 -- a harmless VGA-aperture write in the host harness, same convention as the blitspr/status/aniwalk2 suites) is left, consistent with the file-sibling fd2_play_ani_file_animation_sequence (00020421) and the spellcin.c cinematic workers.

Per-summon palette + SFX-bank-index lookup. The binary copies four 4-byte read-only tables (R@0x5254F / G@0x52553 / B@0x52557 / sfx_bank_index@0x5255B) each into a dword stack slot (MOV [ESP+0x10/0xc/0x8/0x14],EAX @0x27FDA..0x27FFA) and later byte-indexes each slot by (spell_id-0x20) — palette via MOVZX from ((uint8*)&palette_R)[idx] @0x283ED/0x284D4/0x28519, and the sfx_bank_index via MOVZX EAX,byte ptr [ESP+EAX-0xc] @0x28141 (table base = the [ESP+0x14] dword). Emitted C reproduces this exactly: 'palette_R = data_..._r_table;' then '((uint8*)&palette_R)[idx]'. This is endian-dependent: it relies on the uint32 global storing the 4 table bytes little-endian so the byte-index returns the correct table entry; this is EXACT on the x86/DOS target (and the test globals in testglob.c are defined with the real .object3 values LE-packed: R=0x3535333f G=0x3a00393f B=0x09003f3f sfx=0x5e5d5c5b). Behavior equivalent; machine code differs only in that the rebuild reads the 4-byte symbol vs the binary's .object3 dword. The byte-indexing idiom + table values are unit-tested via test_summon_table_indexing in tests/spell/spellcin.c (asserts all four summons' RGB + sfx index). Recommend a post-build -d disasm to confirm the dword-load + MOVZX-byte-index shape.

Phase orchestration + gameplay-effect dispatch DEFERRED to Phase 9 integration (risk-based policy). This is a monolithic VGA/VRAM summon cinematic (spell 0x20/0x21/0x22/0x23): it fopens the real TAI.DAT/BG.DAT/FIGANI.DAT/FDOTHER.DAT/FDSHAP.DAT via fd2_load_dat_resource, mallocs 64000+128KB scratch, and runs 8 animation phases each ending in an unconditional blit to the hardcoded mode-13h framebuffer 0xA0000 via fd2_blit_rectangle, driven by real-linked VRAM-touching callees (fd2_rle_blit_sprite, fd2_play_char_intro_zoom_anim, fd2_play_figani_animation_loop, fd2_blit_indexed_sprite, fd2_interpolate_palette_range_toward_color) with no stubbable seam. The Phase-8 gameplay effects (fd2_apply_attack_spell_damage / fd2_cast_group_hp_heal_spell / fd2_cast_ap|dp|speed_boost_spell / fd2_cast_status_inflict_spell) are themselves animation-bearing and reached only AFTER all 8 cinematic phases. The one isolatable pure computation — the per-summon table byte-indexing — IS unit-tested (see test_summon_table_indexing); the rest matches the deferral of the sibling cinematic workers in this file. Deferral documented in tests/spell/spellcin.c header. Equivalence verified statically against the disassembly @0x27FC9..0x286BC: cdecl 4-arg (caster_idx, spell_id, n_targets, target_id_array) confirmed via stack-offset tracking ([ESP+0x4c]=caster->*0x50 rt_char index, [ESP+0x50]=spell_id compared 0x20..0x23, [ESP+0x54]=n_targets, [ESP+0x58]=target-id array base); the 4th Ghidra param name 'caster_idx' is misleading — it is the target-id array. Self-contained epilogue, explicit RET @0x286BC (no shared-epilogue handoff, unlike siblings).

Same idiom as the zoom-in counterpart (00029c90). The binary indexes the 3-layer BG cache as a uint32[3] at 0x5410B/0F/13 via PUSH dword ptr [EDX*4 + 0x5410B] (EDX = frame%3 in phase 1, (frame+1)%3 in phase 3). globals.h declares the three slots as separate extern uint32 (data_fd2_battle_special_cinematic_bg_layer_0/1/2_buf_ptr), so the emitted C reproduces the array access via 'uint32 *bg_layer = &data_..._layer_0_buf_ptr; bg_layer[idx]'. Well-defined only if the linker places the three globals contiguously in declaration order (4 bytes apart); they ARE defined consecutively (testglob.c, declaration order layer_0,layer_1,layer_2) and Watcom 9.5a lays file-scope objects in definition order within the data segment, matching the original 0x5410B/0F/13 layout.
